tasks.build: deno task data:build && vite build --mode fresh && deno run -A scripts/prepare-cloudflare.ts && vite build --mode cloudflare
tasks.check: deno check src/client.ts src/cloudflare-stub.ts src/main.ts src/utils.ts src/routes/_app.tsx src/routes/index.tsx src/routes/license.tsx src/routes/api/search.ts src/islands/SearchIsland.tsx src/lib/*.ts scripts/*.ts tests/*.ts
tasks.fmt:check: deno fmt --check deno.json src scripts tests vite.config.ts README.md
tasks.lint: deno lint src scripts tests vite.config.ts
tasks.test:coverage: deno test --clean -A --reload --coverage=coverage tests/ && deno coverage --threshold=90 --include="^file:.*/src/lib/" --lcov --output=coverage/lcov.info coverage/
